notes:
LacTracker joins LacBench, BathBot can record with an iTooth, and every app has a light mode.

- LacTracker is now part of LacBench: same download, same version, and it reminds you of LacBench updates. Your sessions and settings stay where they were.
- BathBot: choose EmStat3 or iTooth next to the arm. With an iTooth, the run is saved as a LacTracker session (it shows up in LacTracker) and exported like one. Set the iTooth's measurement settings in LacTracker first.
- Light mode: a System / Light / Dark switch in EmStat Control, BathBot and LacTracker.
- Copy and paste with the system clipboard is turned on in every window.
- LacTracker's icon is now LacBench green.
